title: A finitely presented module free at a prime is free on a principal neighborhood
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $M$ be a finitely presented [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] $A$-module, and let $\mathfrak p$ be a prime ideal of $A$. If $M_{\mathfrak p}$ is a finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] $A_{\mathfrak p}$-module, then there exists $f\in A\setminus\mathfrak p$ such that $M_f$ is a finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] $A_f$-module.
